component.name: Tempo
component.summary: A light video editor that works like DaVinci Resolve's Edit page

description.p: Tempo is a simple video editor for ordinary laptops. It uses the same layout and keyboard shortcuts as DaVinci Resolve's Edit page, so what you learn here carries over when you move on. It needs no graphics card and never converts your footage on import.

ul.li: Cut, trim and arrange clips on up to four video and four audio tracks
Smooth preview on weak processors, with small proxies made in the background
Markers that become chapters in the exported file and in a copyable list

description.p: Alpha. Project Manager folders, Save Project As and Project Settings, Media Pool bins and hover scrubbing, multi-clip editing in the Inspector, more Export formats and codecs, Clip Attributes, more Resolve shortcuts, a startup splash and beginner help.

Alpha. Resolve-style transitions (Additive, Blur, Cross, Dip To Color and Non-Additive Dissolve) with the full Inspector, transition copy and paste, timelines in the Media Pool, a Resolve-style Create New Timeline dialog, marker colours, zoom presets and upload fields on the Export page.
Alpha. Smoother playback of heavy footage, faster proxies with sound, Resolve-style project backups, Change Clip Speed, fade handles, Solo, and a 10 MB export for Discord.
Alpha. Right-click menus, selectable gaps, a preview quality button, linked cuts, and many fixes from the first hands-on test.
First release of the Rust rewrite.
